question: Which powers of destroying battle enemies and granting grace to Sāṅkhya are attributed to the deity?
premises: The deity is honored as destroyer of enemies in battle
The deity is honored as bestower of grace upon Sāṅkhya
inference: The deity embodies both martial destruction of foes and gracious favor toward Sāṅkhya
plain_english: Homage to the destroyer of enemies in battle; homage to the one who grants grace to Sāṅkhya.
